name: Remesso
description: Recurring stablecoin payments on Celo, bound by a mandate the payer signs on-chain. An agent can be paid by a schedule, ask to be paid, pay for services over x402 in USDC, USD₮, USA₮ or Ripio's local-currency stablecoins, or commit its own wallet to paying on a schedule. Nothing can redirect, resize or extend a payment once signed — the contract enforces it, not the operator.

services.name: capabilities
services.description: What this agent does, what it costs, and what it refuses. Free.

services.name: MCP
services.description: Remesso as a remote MCP server for AI assistants (Streamable HTTP; on claude.ai, add it as a custom connector). Its tools prepare payments for the payer to sign in their own wallet, read schedules and balances from the chain, ask to be paid and look up ERC-8004 agents. A person who signs in can also let their hosted agent pay, within limits they set on-chain. Free.

services.name: request-payment
services.description: Ask someone to pay you, check a request's status, or, as the payer, answer it with a schedule or decline it by signature. Free. Advisory: a request prefills a form and decides nothing.

services.name: naira-rate
services.description: Live USDT/NGN and USDC/NGN from on-chain RFQ makers. 0.001 via x402.

services.name: trigger-run
services.description: Bring one payment of an existing schedule forward. 0.01 via x402. The caller buys timing and nothing else. Grant trigger 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001 (CURRENT_EXECUTOR) to allow it.

services.name: latam-rate
services.description: Peso and real pricing on Celo (wARS, wBRL) from two independent sources, side by side. 0.001 via x402.

services.name: latam-route
services.description: Where to convert pesos or reais on Celo at your size, and what it costs. 0.002 via x402.

services.name: payment-events
services.description: Remesso's payment events read from the chain, by address, after a cursor: runs, policy payments, schedules and policies, each marked final or not. Free.

services.name: webhooks
services.description: Have payments to an address delivered to your URL, signed in the Standard Webhooks format. Subscribe with an EIP-712 signature from that address; the URL must echo a challenge first. Free.

payment.note: Take the EIP-712 domain from the 402's extra; match assets by address, not symbol. The six wFIAT settle through Permit2, as the 402 declares.

contracts.name: RemessoExecutorV5
contracts.role: enforces every mandate; the authority on what may move

identity.note: Soulbound to a human verified by zero-knowledge passport proof.
